changeSet.author: grushton

preConditions.onFailMessage: acknowledgement must have 2 timestamp or timestamptz column(s): first_acknowledged, last_acknowledged. Compare the deployed schema with the changesets before you deploy.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = current_schema() AND table_name = 'acknowledgement' AND column_name IN ('first_acknowledged', 'last_acknowledged') AND data_type IN ('timestamp without time zone', 'timestamp with time zone')

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE acknowledgement ALTER COLUMN first_acknowledged TYPE timestamp with time zone, ALTER COLUMN last_acknowledged TYPE timestamp with time zone

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE acknowledgement ALTER COLUMN first_acknowledged TYPE timestamp without time zone, ALTER COLUMN last_acknowledged TYPE timestamp without time zone
